claims.text: Hepatitis B vaccine (w/o HBIG) if assailant status unknown and survivor not previously vaccinated
claims.quote: hepatitis B vaccination (without HBIG) if the hepatitis status of the assailant is unknown and the survivor has not been previously vaccinated.
claims.locator: Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021 (MMWR Recomm Rep 2021;70(4))

claims.text: Assailant known HBsAg positive: unvaccinated survivors get both hepatitis B vaccine and HBIG
claims.quote: If the assailant is known to be HBsAg positive, unvaccinated survivors should receive both hepatitis B vaccine and HBIG.
claims.locator: Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021 (MMWR Recomm Rep 2021;70(4))

claims.text: HPV vaccine for female and male survivors aged 9–26 years not vaccinated or incompletely vaccinated
claims.quote: HPV vaccination for female and male survivors aged 9–26 years who have not been vaccinated or are incompletely vaccinated
claims.locator: Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021 (MMWR Recomm Rep 2021;70(4))
